data.title: Mossad Director Gofman visits Washington, meets CIA director to discuss Iran war | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Gofman's visit comes as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is pushing US President Donald Trump to return to fighting against Iran.
